", "label": "HealthDependency"}> {"description": "Health of each critical downstream dependency (may nest)."} |} {"label": "HealthResponse", "description": "Readiness response returned by `GET /ready`. Aggregates the status of every
critical downstream dependency into an overall `status` value.

At v1 this API has a single direct dependency (the Catalog Products Process
API), which in turn has a single dependency (the SAP System API), which in
turn depends on the MySQL schema simulating SAP. A single call to
`/ready` here returns the full four-node chain via nested
`HealthDependency` entries.

Status mapping:
 - `OK` — every dependency in the tree is `UP`.
 - `DEGRADED` — some dependencies are `DOWN`, others `UP`; the API can
 still serve reduced functionality.
 - `OFFLINE` — every critical dependency is `DOWN`; the API cannot serve
 business requests.
"}
